caption: The drawing depicts a single, ornate jug or pitcher, rendered in shades of brown with detailed, realistic shading. The vessel features a rounded body that narrows slightly at the top, ending in a short neck with a decorated spout. The handle, attached at the neck and the widest part of the body, arches outward gracefully. The body of the jug is adorned with floral and leaf patterns, with two large, stylized flowers and multiple leaves etched into the surface. The lid is dome-shaped, topped with a sculpted decorative element resembling a small animal or bird. The rim of the lid has a band with a pattern, and additional leaf motifs encircle the neck. The jug is centered on a plain, light beige background, with no other objects or elements present in the composition.
title: Teapot
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
